title: Exam Resit Fee
scenario: A text says you can secure a resit slot by paying a small fee to a private account.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Exam Resit Fee: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Assessment fees must be verified through department systems.
